items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: You know, he made some records with Joe Turner, the Blues things

ctx.x: play with a rhythm section, see. Because he had so much, you know...so much piano...

You know, he made some records with Joe Turner, the Blues things, and it seems as though those runs of his, he couldn't... I mean, they seem to be really very out of place there. They sound as though they were almost out of control.

Well, he couldn't accompany a singer, I wouldn't say, because he couldn't subjugate himself to that. He himself used to sing like the way he plays, you know. He played for Billie Holiday, and poor Billie, you know; you just had so much piano being played, Billie couldn't... It's difficult for a person like that to...
